cases.sentence: На двадцать седьмом ___ в Иудее начал царствовать Азария.
cases.translation: In the twenty-seventh year, Azariah began to reign in Judah.
cases.explain: The preposition на with the prepositional case indicates the time period.

cases.sentence: На той ___, которая была отец ему Амассия, он делал то, что было правильным.
cases.translation: Following his father Amaziah, he did what was right.
cases.explain: The prepositional case with в indicates location or circumstances.

cases.sentence: Его мать звали Иехолия, она была родом из ___.
cases.translation: His mother was Jecoliah, she was from Jerusalem.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Господь поразил ___ проказой до самой его смерти.
cases.translation: The Lord struck the king with leprosy until his death.
cases.explain: The direct object of the transitive verb поразил takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Азария был похоронен рядом с предками в городе ___.
cases.translation: Azariah was buried with his ancestors in the city of David.
cases.explain: The possessive genitive shows the city belonged to David.

cases.sentence: Каждый богатый ___ был обязан внести пятьдесят шекелей серебра.
cases.translation: Every wealthy man was required to pay fifty shekels of silver.
cases.explain: The subject of the sentence uses the nominative case.

cases.translation: Menahem gave one thousand talents of silver to the king.
cases.explain: The dative case shows the indirect object, the recipient of the gift.

cases.sentence: Иотам крепко держался ___ и неотступно следовал за ним.
cases.translation: Jotham clung to the Lord and steadfastly followed Him.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used with the preposition от (from) and держался (held/clung to).

reading.ru: На двадцать седьмом году правления Иераваама, царя Израиля, в Иудее начал царствовать Азария, сын Амассии.
reading.question: Who became king of Judah during the reign of Jeroboam?
reading.explain: The text states that Azariah, son of Amaziah, began to reign in Judah.

reading.ru: Ему было шестнадцать лет, когда он стал царем, и правил он в Иерусалиме пятьдесят два года.
reading.question: How long did Azariah reign?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states that Azariah reigned in Jerusalem for fifty-two years.

reading.ru: Господь поразил царя проказой до самой его смерти, и он жил в отдельном доме.
reading.question: What afflicted the king according to this passage?
reading.explain: The text says the Lord struck the king with leprosy (проказой) until his death.

reading.ru: На тридцать восьмом году правления Азарии, царя Иудеи, царем Израиля стал Захария, сын Иераваама, и правил в Самарии шесть месяцев.
reading.question: How long did Zechariah reign in Samaria?
reading.explain: The text states that Zechariah reigned in Samaria for six months.

reading.ru: Он делал зло в глазах Господа, подобно своим отцам.
reading.question: What did Zechariah do that displeased the Lord?
options: He did evil like his fathers
reading.correct: He did evil like his fathers
reading.explain: The text says Zechariah did what was evil in the sight of the Lord, like his fathers did.

reading.ru: Азария упокоился со своими предками и был похоронен рядом с ними в городе Давида.
reading.question: Where was Azariah buried?
options: In the city of David with his ancestors
In Samaria with the kings of Israel
reading.correct: In the city of David with his ancestors
reading.explain: The text explicitly states that Azariah was buried with his ancestors in the city of David.
